Kadaikutty Singam | Review By Manoj Aswin | A Nice Family Entertainer

4 out of 54/5
Posted By : Manoj Aswin | Date : 26-07-2018

Kadaikutty Singam, is worth watching...

This movie has a plot of a family entertainer but this lacks in the second half a little. This movie attracts every family audience and we know that some people who comes with their families will definitely enjoy.

Kadaikutty Singam is totally a good family entertainer which shows some points about farming. Farming is explained seldomly in the movie .The college speech and the sneak peek are the only two scenes which shows something about farming.

Music Review- 3.5/5

It's like watching a good movie which also has good background music and good songs.

Final verdict: Very good movie a nice family entertainer.worth a watch in theatre.
